messages:
Anya: Quick async standup — SDKs & samplelib status. TL;DR: samplelib smoke green locally, TS SDK beta pushed, need one PR review, CI flaky on macos-latest.

Mike: Ran smoke on ubuntu-latest and mac-arm, passed. macos-x86 timed out on pytest (socket hangup).

Sophia: I'll take the docs edits for samplelib README + usage examples, will push a PR this afternoon.

Ben: Opened PR #482 for TS SDK docs + sample app. Small auth example tweak. @Sophia can you eyeball the auth snippet?

Anya: Assigning to @Sophia. Also spotted CI-bot rerunning the `publish-wheel` workflow twice — looks like a transient network error. @CI-bot any logs?

CI-bot: build 482.2 failed on macos-latest with `pip install samplelib==0.3.2` timeout, retry scheduled (attempt 2/3).

DocsBot: Auto-link inserted for /sdk/ts -> samplelib usage. If that's wrong, reply with `unlink`. :robot_face:

Sophia: pushing docs PR in a minute. Usage example to include: 
```
npm install @redwood/samplelib@beta
import { init } from '@redwood/samplelib'
await init({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```

Anya: Blocker: need one reviewer to approve the TS SDK canary so we can run the dedicated onboarding demo tomorrow morning. If canary doesn't go out, demo will use hosted fallback.

Mike: I can approve after the second smoke run completes — will watch CI and approve if mac-arm & ubuntu succeed.

Ben: Can someone volunteer to run Windows CI smoke (appveyor / windows-latest)? I can't repro locally.

Sophia: I can run the windows smoke later today. Will report back with logs.

Anya: Great — thanks everyone. Plan: Sophia lands docs fixes, Mike approves canary after smoke, I merge and trigger canary. I'll ping before the rollout. :thumbsup:
